question: What did Rumelhart, Hinton & Williams (1986) popularize so multi-layer neural networks could learn?
explanation: Backpropagation sends error gradients backward through hidden layers so internal weights adjust cleanly.

question: Which three ingredients combined in AlexNet (2012) to slash ImageNet top-5 error from ~26% to ~15%?
options: Deep CNNs + ImageNet labeled data + parallel GPUs
explanation: AlexNet launched the GPU deep learning era by pairing deep CNNs with ImageNet data and GPU training.

question: Why did 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017) replace RNNs with Self-Attention?
options: Self-Attention processes all tokens in parallel on GPUs and links long-range context directly
Transformers update weights permanently during chat prompts
explanation: Eliminating sequential recurrence allowed full GPU parallelization and direct attention across long contexts.
